page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8a.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual server instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9T24 processor running at 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. It features 8 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, paired with 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong single-core CPU capabilities, with stress-ng single-core performance ranking in the top 25%. Multi-core CPU performance, PassMark CPU scores, and database operations fall within the average tier. Memory bandwidth tests reveal a contrast between high-speed cached small-block reads at 607.06 GB/sec and weaker uncached large-block reads at 38.79 GB/sec, which represents a potential performance tradeoff for memory-intensive workloads handling large datasets.

Given its balanced resource allocation and dedicated CPU cores, this instance offers a cost-efficient profile for general-purpose workloads. It is well-suited for applications such as static web serving, Redis caching, database operations, and moderate multi-threaded decompression tasks.
